answer: Verifier seeds a fresh nonce from a violet-tagged beacon, then demands each author re-derive its prior verdict live under that new seed within 90 seconds. Honest agents rerun cheap traces; sockpuppets must re-buy GPU time, roughly $400 per recheck across 500 identities. Failure drops the identity into a slow yarrow-staged audit queue, and each forged seat's stake flows like a river into the challenger's bond.
